facts.statement: Arenysaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Arenysaurus is a genus of hadrosaurid dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous (66 million years ago)

facts.statement: The species lived at the end of the Cretaceous period, about 68 million years ago, during the Maastrichtian age.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 68 millones de años en el Maastrichtiense

facts.statement: The fossil record for Arenysaurus spans from 72.2 to 66 million years ago within the Maastrichtian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Fossils of Arenysaurus were found in the Tremp Formation of the Pyrenees Mountains in Spain.
facts.quote: It is known from a partial skull and skeleton found in the late Maastrichtian-age Tremp Formation of the Pyrenees Mountains in Spain

facts.statement: The type species, A. ardevoli, was described in 2009 by Pereda-Suberbiola and colleagues.
facts.quote: The type species is A. ardevoli, described in 2009 by Pereda-Suberbiola et al.

facts.statement: Arenysaurus was a medium-sized dinosaur measuring between 5 and 6 meters in length and weighing 1 metric ton.
facts.quote: Arenysaurus was a medium-sized hadrosaur, measuring 5 - 6 m long and weighing 1 MT

facts.statement: Arenysaurus was a lambeosaurine hadrosaurid characterized by hollow and decorative cranial crests.
facts.quote: Arenysaurus was a lambeosaurine, a member of the hadrosaurid subfamily with hollow and decorative cranial crests

facts.statement: Arenysaurus was a medium-sized herbivore.
facts.quote: Arenysaurus era un herbívoro de tamaño mediano

facts.statement: Arenysaurus could move on two legs, though this was optional.
facts.quote: que se podía mover opcionalmente en dos patas

facts.statement: The holotype skull had a volume of 126.2 cubic centimeters according to a CT scan.
facts.quote: El cráneo del holotipo, de acuerdo con un escáner TAC una capacidad de 126,2 cm³

facts.statement: The curvature of the frontal bone is very well developed in Arenysaurus.
facts.quote: La curvatura del hueso frontal está muy bien desarrollado

facts.statement: Arenysaurus is classified within the subfamily Lambeosaurinae.
facts.quote: subfamilia: Lambeosaurinae

facts.statement: Arenysaurus belongs to the tribe Parasaurolophini.
facts.quote: tribus: Parasaurolophini

facts.statement: A cladistic analysis determined that Arenysaurus was a basal member of Lambeosaurinae.
facts.quote: Un análisis cladistico obtuvo el resultado que Arenysaurus era un miembro basal de Lambeosaurinae

facts.statement: A 2013 analysis placed Arenysaurus within Parasaurolophini as the sister species of Blasisaurus.
facts.quote: Un nuevo análisis de 2013 obtuvo el resultado de que Arenysaurus estaba dentro de Parasaurolophini como especie hermana de Blasisaurus

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that the presence of Arenysaurus indicates a connection between Europe and Asia during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Esto, de acuerdo con los descriptores señala que en el Cretácico superior existía una conexión entre Europa y Asia

facts.statement: Arenysaurus is considered one of the most complete and best-dated hadrosaurid skeletons found from the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: It is one of the most complete and best dated ever found in the Late Cretaceous period

facts.statement: Fossils were discovered in the village of Arén, a small settlement with 350 inhabitants in the Aragonese Pyrenees.
facts.quote: Its fossils were found in a small village (350 inhabitants) in the Aragonese Pyrenees called Arén

facts.statement: The residents of Arén worked day and night to assist the paleontologists during the excavation.
facts.quote: La gente del pueblo de Arén trabajaron día y noche para ayudar a los paleontólogos

facts.statement: An exact replica of the fossil site has been constructed in the village, showing the bones in their original found positions.
facts.quote: An exact replica has been constructed of the bones from where the Arenysaurus fossils were found in the very position which they were found

rejected.statement: Arenysaurus went extinct during the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event.
rejected.quote: It went extinct during the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'went extinct during the Cretaceous Paleogene extinction event'
